Aquí, formar parte del equipo significa crecer juntos. Buscamos personas que quieran formarse para evolucionar constantemente, asumir un papel protagonista en su carrera y construir una trayectoria sólida dentro de un grupo fuerte, en constante expansión y movimiento. title: Client Partner, Key Accounts (Ad-Sales) - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the role:
TikTok is seeking a Client Partner (what we call 'Brand Partnerships Manager') to support our Key Accounts (Enterprise) business and be based out of the Mexico City office. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in cross-network solutions selling and a proven ability to reach and influence executive level customers to drive new business. The candidate will have operational knowledge of in-region clients and experience dealing with executive stakeholders across Social, Video, Mobile, Digital teams. A proven track record in scaling client investment is a must.
Above all, the candidate will have an established track record of building strong relationships across key stakeholders. The role will involve working cross-functionally with members of the TikTok sales organization with the intent of onboarding priority accounts across the market. You’ll bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to building and growing long term business partnerships across advertising technology partners.

Responsibilities:
1. Identify, prioritize, and secure business opportunities
2. Drive revenue for TikTok by seeking partnerships with various direct clients and agencies 
3. Use consultative approach by offering strategic media solutions with all clients 
4. Create compelling sales propositions utilizing internal and external data for respective regions
5. Liaise with cross-functional teams on structuring and executing operational and strategic initiatives
6. Create persuasive sales presentations using market trends and case studies
7. Update clients on TikTok products and developments and educate clients and agencies on best practices

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
1. 5+ years of marketing, brand advertising, media sales, and/or online advertising experience
2. Expert knowledge of social media, mobile apps, and digital and mobile marketing
3. Knowledge of the self-serve platform, auction, and biddable form of digital advertising buying
4. Proven performance winning the support of key stakeholders
5. Proven track record of reaching and exceeding sales goals
6. High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets.

Preferred Qualifications:
1. Ability to perform well in a rapidly changing environment
2. Creative, outside-the-box thinker and strategist
3. Excellent communication and presentation skills
4. Passion for TikTok marketing, and up for the challenge of building something from the bottom up

In-Office Policy: We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and are moving to 5x a week in office (full-time) starting Fall 2026.

*Only resumes submitted in English will be considered*

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Senior Executive Search, GOC

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Search who will:


Develop strong relationships with counterparts in WPP Media’s regional teams (Europe, United States and Asia). 
Support the implementation of digital campaigns and ads according to guidelines with platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, Search Ads 360, etc. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines. 
Monitor campaigns daily on each of the platforms and ensure accuracy of data across platforms for campaign reporting. 
Generate daily campaign reports for reporting to regional Search teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of experience implementing paid Search campaigns on platforms such as Google Ads, Bing Ads, Amazon Search, etc. 
Advanced Excel skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About the job

About Smart Capital Center

Smart Capital Center is an AI-powered platform built for Commercial Real Estate (CRE) investment and financial management in the U.S. market.

Our platform combines real-time data intelligence, workflow automation, and AI-driven insights to support underwriting, asset management, and portfolio analytics for institutional real estate firms.

We operate at the intersection of AI, finance, and commercial real estate, helping investment teams work faster, make smarter decisions, and scale operations more efficiently.

This is a hands-on marketing role for someone who is highly organized, tech-savvy, creative, and excited to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment.

You will work closely with leadership and operations teams to execute digital marketing initiatives, manage content workflows, improve online visibility, and support the company’s growth strategy.




This role is ideal for candidates who learn quickly, enjoy working with modern AI tools, and want to build real-world experience in technology-driven marketing operations.

We are looking for highly capable, execution-focused individuals who are proactive, adaptable, and eager to grow.

Requirements

Strong English communication skills (C1/C2 proficiency required)
Tech-savvy with strong digital literacy
Fast learner with a strong willingness to adopt new tools and systems

Strong organizational and multitasking skills

title: Responsable superior de marketing
description:
About the job

We're hiring: Senior Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist — Financial Services | 100% Remote




Arvenda is a staffing company connecting top LATAM talent with U.S.-based clients. We are recruiting a Senior Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist for a specialized financial advisory firm that helps U.S. businesses restructure and recover from Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) debt.




The closing team is strong. What they need now is someone to build and own the pipeline that feeds it.




This is not a role for someone who executes someone else's playbook. We need someone who builds the system, runs it, and delivers warm, qualified opportunities directly to the advisory and legal team — ready for closure.




Schedule: Full-time · 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CST · Slight flexibility for exceptional candidates




The salary is $1,600–$1,800 USD, depending on your experience.




What you'll do




Design and execute a comprehensive B2B outbound prospecting strategy targeting U.S. businesses struggling with MCA debt or in need of financial restructuring




Identify, capture, and organize prospect data to build a highly qualified, active sales pipeline




Conduct multi-channel outreach via cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels




Qualify prospects before passing them to the advisory team — only warm, sales-ready leads reach the closing team




Build, maintain, and optimize prospect records and pipeline stages in Salesforce




Develop and refine outreach messaging, sequences, and scripts that resonate with financially distressed business owners




Monitor pipeline metrics: lead volume, quality, conversion rates, and outreach performance




Proactively identify new prospecting channels and data sources to maximize pipeline throughput




Operate fully independently — build the system, run it, and improve it without daily direction




What we're looking for




4+ years of proven experience in B2B marketing, outbound lead generation, or pipeline management — required




Demonstrated ability to build a lead generation system from scratch — not just execute an existing one




Exceptional English (C1/C2) with a highly neutral, professional accent — you'll speak directly with U.S. business owners in high-stakes financial situations




Advanced Salesforce proficiency — disciplined, consistent CRM management




Strong multi-channel outbound experience: cold calling, email sequencing, LinkedIn prospecting




100% self-starter — proactive, autonomous, results-driven without micromanagement




Strong analytical mindset — you track your own metrics and adjust based on data




Nice to have — significant plus




Prior experience in MCA, alternative lending, debt restructuring, or U.S. financial services




Familiarity with MCA industry language and the profile of business owners who need restructuring




Experience with data sourcing tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)




Experience with email automation platforms (Outreach, Instantly, Lemlist, or similar)




How to apply

Send your English CV to jerelyn@arvenda.com with the subject line "Sr Lead Gen Specialist – [Your Name]". Applications without an English CV will not be considered.




Learn more about Arvenda: Arvenda LLC on LinkedIn · www.arvenda.com




#LeadGeneration #B2BMarketing #OutboundSales #MCA #FinancialServices #RemoteJobsLATAM #HiringNow #Arvenda

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About the job

Senior Software Engineer (Fullstack)

Acerca del rol

Buscamos un Senior Software Engineer para diseñar, construir y modernizar soluciones digitales que resuelvan problemas reales de usuarios y negocio.

Buscamos más que experiencia desarrollando software: queremos autonomía, pensamiento crítico, criterio técnico, orientación a producto y ownership end-to-end.

Trabajarás con equipos multidisciplinarios utilizando prácticas modernas de ingeniería, Cloud e Inteligencia Artificial para acelerar el delivery sin comprometer calidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad.




 Acerca del Puesto

En Deacero estamos evolucionando Solutions Factory enfocada en plataformas digitales, modernización tecnológica, automatización, observabilidad y adopción de soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial. Para nosotros, ser Senior no se define únicamente por años de experiencia o dominio de un stack.

Buscamos Software Engineer Fullstack capaces de diseñar, construir y operar productos digitales end-to-end: desde la interfaz que usa el negocio hasta los microservicios, integraciones y datos que la sostienen, corriendo sobre plataformas cloud (GCP) e integrados con el ecosistema corporativo on-premise.

Misión

Construir y evolucionar productos digitales de alta calidad, componibles y observables, que resuelvan problemas reales de negocio; participando desde el entendimiento del problema hasta la operación en producción, con estándares de ingeniería que hagan el software mantenible y escalable en el tiempo. 

Esperamos que puedas:

· Recibir problemas, no sólo tickets: entender la necesidad y cuestionar constructivamente la solución propuesta.

· Trabajar con ambigüedad: investigar, generar hipótesis, buscar evidencia y avanzar con autonomía.

· Entender antes de modificar: realizar System Archaeology sobre código, arquitectura, datos, APIs, integraciones y sistemas legacy.

· Entender el dato: identificar origen, transformaciones, dependencias y Data Lineage entre sistemas.

· Pensar en sistemas: considerar arquitectura, seguridad, performance, resiliencia, observabilidad y mantenibilidad.

· Aplicar pensamiento crítico: identificar causas raíz, riesgos, alternativas y trade-offs.

· Ser responsable del outcome: llevar las soluciones desde discovery hasta producción y validar su impacto.

· Crear claridad: documentar decisiones, arquitectura y conocimiento técnico para reducir dependencias.

· Elevar al equipo: compartir conocimiento, hacer coaching y ayudar a otros engineers a desarrollar autonomía.

· Balancear velocidad y sostenibilidad: entregar valor sin generar deuda técnica innecesaria.




Responsabilidades

Software Engineering & Solution Design

· Diseñar, desarrollar, probar y mantener soluciones de software.

· Construir código limpio, mantenible, seguro y testeable.

· Diseñar APIs, servicios, integraciones y soluciones basadas en datos.

· Participar en decisiones de arquitectura, NFRs y ADRs.

· Evaluar alternativas y comunicar trade-offs técnicos.




System Archaeology, Modernización & Data Lineage

· Investigar sistemas legacy y codebases desconocidos.

· Reconstruir arquitectura, dependencias, integraciones y reglas de negocio.

· Rastrear origen, transformación y consumo de datos.

· Identificar deuda técnica, riesgos y oportunidades de modernización.

· Convertir conocimiento técnico en documentación reutilizable.




AI-Enabled Engineering

· Utilizar herramientas como Cursor, Claude/Claude Code, Gemini, GitHub Copilot o equivalentes.

· Aplicar IA en desarrollo, testing, debugging, refactoring, documentación y discovery técnico.

· Automatizar trabajo repetitivo y acelerar el ciclo de desarrollo.

· Validar siempre la calidad, seguridad y exactitud del código generado con IA.




Quality, Reliability & Delivery

· Implementar pruebas automatizadas y participar en Code Reviews.

· Trabajar con CI/CD, observabilidad y prácticas de desarrollo seguro.

· Participar desde discovery y diseño hasta deployment y producción.

· Resolver problemas mediante análisis de causa raíz.

· Trabajar efectivamente bajo metodologías Agile, tradicionales o híbridas.




Product & Value Delivery

· Entender las necesidades de usuarios y negocio antes de construir.

· Colaborar con Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data y Platform.

· Identificar riesgos, dependencias y supuestos de manera temprana.

· Descomponer problemas complejos en entregas incrementales.

· Conectar decisiones técnicas con resultados para usuarios finales.




Technical Leadership & Coaching

· Realizar Code Reviews y acompañamiento técnico.

· Hacer mentoring, coaching y pairing con otros engineers.

· Facilitar conversaciones y decisiones técnicas.

· Compartir conocimiento y promover autonomía dentro del equipo.

· Mejorar continuamente prácticas, herramientas y estándares de ingeniería.




Experiencia y conocimientos

· Experiencia sólida como Software Engineer desarrollando soluciones productivas.

· Dominio de al menos un lenguaje y ecosistema moderno de desarrollo.

· Experiencia con APIs, integraciones y bases de datos SQL y/o NoSQL.

· Conocimiento de arquitectura de software y sistemas distribuidos.

· Experiencia con GCP, AWS o Azure.

· Experiencia con Git, CI/CD, testing automatizado y prácticas modernas de deployment.

· Experiencia trabajando con metodologías Agile y/o tradicionales.

· Capacidad para investigar sistemas desconocidos y resolver problemas complejos.

· Experiencia trabajando con equipos multidisciplinarios.

· Experiencia realizando mentoring o coaching técnico.

· Comunicación efectiva con audiencias técnicas y de negocio.




Stack & herramientas

Dependiendo de la solución podrás trabajar con: 

· Backend y/o frontend moderno.

· REST APIs y arquitecturas event-driven.

· SQL y NoSQL.

· GCP, AWS o Azure.

· Containers y Kubernetes.

· Git y CI/CD.

· Observabilidad y monitoreo.

· Testing automatizado.

· Cursor, Claude/Claude Code, Gemini, GitHub Copilot u otras herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA.




Valoramos fundamentos sólidos de ingeniería, pensamiento crítico y capacidad de aprendizaje por encima del dominio de un stack específico.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, ensuring our agentic delivery processes are well-defined, auditable, and aligned with stakeholder expectations. This is a fantastic opportunity for a bilingual professional based in Latin America to work remotely with a global team on cutting-edge delivery frameworks.

Conduct discovery sessions with business and technical stakeholders to capture requirements, pain points, and opportunities for agentic solutions


Translate business needs into clear, actionable specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria


Document workflows, data flows, and edge cases to ensure comprehensive coverage before development begins

2. Product Owner & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a liaison between Product Owners, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to align priorities and expectations


Facilitate regular check-ins, backlog grooming sessions, and requirement reviews


Gather and synthesize feedback from multiple stakeholders to refine product direction and reduce ambiguity

3. Delivery & Cadence Flow

Support sprint planning, tracking, and reporting to ensure delivery milestones are met on schedule


Monitor delivery cadence and proactively identify bottlenecks, risks, or dependencies that could impact timelines


Coordinate cross-functional communication to maintain a smooth and predictable delivery rhythm

4. Control Evidence & Audit Readiness

Maintain thorough documentation and evidence trails to support internal controls and compliance requirements


Prepare audit-ready materials, ensuring traceability between requirements, decisions, and delivered outcomes


Partner with risk and compliance teams to ensure all agentic delivery processes meet governance standards

5. Operating Model Adoption

Champion the adoption of standardized operating models and best practices across delivery teams


Provide training, guidance, and support to teams transitioning to new agentic delivery frameworks


Continuously assess and recommend improvements to the operating model based on real-world delivery feedback


Requirements:




Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish (written and verbal)
Experience with Agile Methodologies
Insurance Industry experience
Based in Latin America, with the ability to work remotely and collaborate across time zones
Proven experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within agile, digital, or technology-driven delivery environments
Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills
Familiarity with agentic systems, AI-driven workflows, or similar emerging delivery models 
Comfortable working with cross-functional and multicultural teams

A Creative Problem-Solver: You love a challenge and enjoy figuring out how to use new technology, including APIs, to solve creative problems, build internal tools, and optimize workflows.

About the job

Role Title: Technical Problem Author (Multi-Domain)




Role Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




micro1 is engaging Technical Problem Authors (Multi-Domain) to contribute to a customer's project focused on advancing the capabilities of AI technologies in engineering. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.




Scope of Work

Author and evaluate advanced technical problems in your area of expertise, such as Aerodynamics, Materials Science, CAD/Mechanical Design, Circuit Design, or Mechanical Engineering.
Review and assess AI-generated technical responses for correctness, accuracy, and engineering relevance.
Apply practical engineering judgment to real-world design, analysis, and failure scenarios, along with theoretical problem contexts.
Analyze and troubleshoot complex, domain-specific issues, identifying ambiguities and proposing clarifications in technical statements and conditions.
Provide structured feedback and clear written and verbal explanations to support and enhance AI learning and reasoning capabilities.
Collaborate remotely with a network of technical experts and project participants to deliver high-quality domain input.
Document insights and recommendations to inform continuous model improvement and refinement of problem statements.




Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in a relevant engineering discipline, or substantial industry experience (8+ years for Aerodynamics/Circuit Design/Mechanical Engineering; 5+ years for CAD/Mechanical Design).
At least 5 years of hands-on technical experience in your domain, such as mechanical design, aerodynamic analysis, materials selection, or circuit/system development.
Demonstrated track record in technical problem authoring (e.g., olympiad problem committees, licensure exam item writing, academic qualifying-exam authorship, standards committee roles, or technical competition leadership).
Flagship publications, patents, or industry awards recognized within your field, or evidence of technical rigor through competition results or committee service.
Professional-level English proficiency and exceptional written and verbal communication skills are essential.
Familiarity with industry-standard engineering tools (e.g., AutoCAD, CAD suites, CFD/FEA software, EDA tools, or lab equipment) relevant to your specialty.
Experience working independently and remotely, contributing high-quality deliverables within required project timelines.




Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert's experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.




Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: Encargado de redes sociales
description:
About the job

Mánager de contenido y redes con experiencia y conocimientos en el sector cripto / fintech / web3.




**No solicites el puesto si no tienes conocimientos demostrables en el sector, tu solicitud será rechazada inmediatamente.




Invedx con SoyIvanInversor como principal canal de distribución de Ivan Prats sobre cripto, mercados e inversión, en español.




El formato principal son directos de mercado varias veces por semana. De cada directo sale todo lo demás: clips, hilos, posts, comunidad.




RESPONSABILIDADES




Convertir cada directo en crecimiento.




Después de cada emisión:




- Eliges los 5–8 momentos que de verdad paran el scroll y escribes el hook y el copy de cada uno.

- Recortas, editas y publicas desde las cuentas del canal en YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels y X, a ritmo de 2–3 clips al día. Los clips de un directo salen en menos de 24 horas.

- Escribes el hilo de X de cada directo y publicas avisos de cada transmisión.

- Respondes comentarios en la primera hora, limpias spam y clasificas los DMs.

- Cada semana entregas un reporte simple: clips, plataformas, views, retención, seguidores ganados, highlights de la comunidad (comentarios) y propones dos cambios para la semana siguiente.

Tu objetivo no es sólo publicar clips, sino analizar rendimiento y buscar crecimiento, publicar sin resultados no sirve.




REQUISITOS




- Experiencia manejando redes sociales con enfoque a crecimiento.

- Experiencia editando (ya sea con programas como Premiere y After effects, o con IA).

- Entiendes cripto y mercados lo suficiente para saber qué momento de un directo importa hoy y cuál no importará mañana.

- Sabes leer e interpretar datos de las plataformas sociales; retención, CTR, seguidores por clip, y propones adaptaciones en base a los datos.

- Autonomía real en remoto, no esperas a que te digan qué hacer, eres proactivo/a.




CONDICIONES




- Tiempo completo, 100 % remoto (Latam o España), contrato como freelance/autónomo.

- Base de USD 1.500–2.500 al mes según lo que demuestres, más bono por resultados de crecimiento.

This is not a traditional marketing execution role. We are looking for someone who understands how to build and activate strategic relationships, channel partnerships, demand-generation programs, and go-to-market strategies that directly contribute to business growth.




The ideal candidate has significant experience working with both private-sector and public-sector organizations, understands complex B2B sales environments, and can operate confidently with senior executives, partners, institutions, and internal leadership teams.

You will work closely with the leadership and commercial teams to define and execute the marketing and lead-generation strategy, while taking ownership of strategic channel relationships.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Channel Partnerships & Strategic Relationships

• Own and develop Shokworks' channel partnership strategy across relevant markets and industries.

• Identify, evaluate, establish, and manage strategic relationships with potential partners, referral sources, technology partners, consulting firms, agencies, and other business channels.

• Build long-term relationships that generate qualified business opportunities and expand Shokworks' market reach.

• Develop partner engagement strategies, including joint go-to-market initiatives, co-marketing opportunities, referrals, events, and strategic campaigns.

• Maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers across partner organizations.

• Identify opportunities to leverage existing networks and partnerships to accelerate pipeline generation.

• Collaborate with the sales and leadership teams to convert partnerships into measurable commercial opportunities.

Marketing Strategy & Lead Generation

• Develop and own the overall marketing and lead-generation strategy in collaboration with the leadership and commercial teams.

• Build demand-generation programs focused on qualified B2B opportunities rather than vanity metrics.

• Define target audiences, market segments, buyer personas, positioning, messaging, and acquisition strategies.

• Develop integrated campaigns across digital, content, outbound, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels.

• Work closely with Sales to establish a strong marketing-to-pipeline process.

• Identify new channels, markets, and opportunities for customer acquisition.

• Track campaign performance, lead quality, conversion, and pipeline contribution.

• Use data and market intelligence to continuously optimize marketing initiatives.




PUBLIC & PRIVATE SECTOR EXPERIENCE

• Develop marketing and relationship strategies applicable to both private-sector and public-sector organizations.

• Understand different decision-making processes, procurement environments, stakeholder structures, and communication requirements across both sectors.

• Identify opportunities to position Shokworks' capabilities within complex institutional and enterprise environments.

• Support strategic proposals, presentations, events, partnerships, and initiatives targeting senior stakeholders.




AI-NATIVE MARKETING

AI must be deeply embedded in how you approach this role.

• Use AI as a core component of marketing strategy, research, content development, campaign development, personalization, lead generation, and market intelligence.

• Identify opportunities to automate and improve marketing workflows using AI.

• Leverage modern AI tools and platforms to increase marketing velocity, efficiency, and quality.

• Understand how AI is transforming B2B marketing, customer acquisition, and business development.

• Experiment with AI-native approaches rather than relying exclusively on traditional marketing methodologies.

• Work effectively with AI agents, automation systems, LLMs, and AI-powered marketing technologies.

• Help the organization develop a modern, AI-native approach to demand generation and market expansion.




REQUIREMENTS

• 8+ years of professional experience in Marketing, Growth, Demand Generation, Business Development, Channel Marketing, Partnerships, or related strategic roles.

• Proven experience managing channel partnerships and strategic business relationships.

• Strong track record of generating qualified B2B leads and contributing to pipeline growth.

• Professional experience working with both private-sector and public-sector organizations.

• Experience operating in complex B2B, enterprise, institutional, or consulting environments.

• Strong understanding of go-to-market strategy, demand generation, positioning, and lead-generation frameworks.

• Demonstrated ability to work directly with senior executives and decision-makers.

• Strong commercial understanding and the ability to connect marketing activity to revenue and business outcomes.

• AI-native mindset with advanced practical use of AI tools and workflows.

• Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.

• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.

• Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate at a high strategic level.

• Must be based in Mexico.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for someone who is:

• Significantly senior and more strategically experienced than a traditional Marketing Manager.

• A strategic thinker who can build the strategy, not simply execute a predefined marketing plan.

• Highly relationship-driven and comfortable developing executive-level partnerships.

• Commercially minded and focused on generating real opportunities and revenue.

• Comfortable navigating both corporate/private-sector and public-sector environments.

• Proactive, entrepreneurial, and capable of creating opportunities from the ground up.

• AI-native and highly comfortable incorporating AI into day-to-day marketing and business-growth activities.

• Able to operate across Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, and Business Development.

• Comfortable working with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.




SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

Success will be measured by the ability to:

• Build and activate a strong channel-partner ecosystem.

• Generate qualified leads and measurable pipeline through marketing and partnerships.

• Establish valuable relationships with strategic organizations and decision-makers.

• Develop scalable marketing and demand-generation strategies.

• Create measurable opportunities across both private and public-sector markets.

• Increase marketing efficiency through AI, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

• Establish a modern, AI-native marketing engine that supports Shokworks' broader growth strategy.




ABOUT SHOKWORKS

At Shokworks, we operate at the intersection of AI, technology, business transformation, and software engineering. We work with organizations facing complex operational and technological challenges and help them leverage AI, automation, and digital products to create measurable business impact.

This is an opportunity for a senior marketing professional who wants to play a meaningful role in building relationships, creating demand, expanding market presence, and shaping how an AI-native company goes to market.

description:
About the job

Wonolo (Work Now Locally) is disrupting the $140BN temporary staffing industry. Founded in 2014, Wonolo's mission is to help people find consistent work. Through our two-sided tech marketplace, we connect hundreds of businesses in need of front-line workers with 2 million underemployed workers in local markets across the United States, within minutes. Wonolo has raised over $200M in funding which will continue to help us empower the in-demand workforce by democratizing access to flexible work, opportunities to learn new skills, a living wage, and comprehensive portable benefits and perks.




We are looking for a Growth Marketing Associate to work with Wonolo’s Marketing team. You will be employed by a third-party legal entity authorized to do business in the location in which you reside and you will provide contractual services to Wonolo’s Marketing team. We're building the B2C acquisition and activation machine that brings workers to Wonolo, helps them succeed on their first job, and keeps them coming back. You'll be the technical builder behind that machine, working alongside the team that leads funnel and lifecycle strategy, translating defined priorities into automations, AI-powered flows, and campaigns that run at scale.




You operate autonomously, with market data as your primary input for deciding where to focus and what to activate. You'll partner closely with the Business Operations team when you need qualitative context on specific customers or market conditions that the data doesn't capture. You'll use that context to prioritize where to activate, what campaign response fits the moment, and how your work contributes to revenue attainment across markets.




The right person thinks like a marketer and builds with low-code and AI tools. You're execution-oriented, detail-driven, and motivated by seeing your work directly move supply-side metrics. Are you excited about working with a close-knit team at a mission-driven, US-based technology company? If this is who you are or you can and desperately want to be, please read on!




We welcome qualified candidates located anywhere in Latin America #LI-Remote.




Who you are:




Campaign Execution

Monitor market health data across active markets independently and activate the right campaign response: new customer launching, customer ramping, low fill rate, supply churn, geographic supply gaps, and similar demand factors
Own campaign prioritization and execution end-to-end: pulling the right audience, selecting the right channel and message, turning campaigns on, and tracking performance through to outcome
Partner with the Business Operations team to gather qualitative intel on specific customers or market conditions that analytical data doesn't capture, and use it to sharpen decisions you're already making
Work from established playbooks while flagging when market conditions call for something outside the standard response
Report campaign performance back to the team with a clear read on what worked and what to adjust




Campaign Automation & Activation

Use your campaign execution work as the foundation for everything you build, leveraging what you learn from running campaigns to inform what you turn into scalable systems.
Map the worker journey from acquisition through activation to understand where friction lives, then build automations and AI-powered flows that remove it
Translate funnel strategy into systems: triggered campaigns, onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and the logic that runs them
Build tooling to test and iterate on activation and retention campaigns across markets so the team can move fast without manual effort
Build high-leverage automations that enable fast campaign activation across organic and paid channels, including social, job boards, answer engine optimization, and search




AI-Native Workflows

Identify marketing workflows that are still manual and rebuild them to be AI-native, focusing on where AI can improve speed, personalization, or conversion outcomes
Build AI agent workflows that support acquisition, content, and competitive intelligence, covering prompts, data sources, structured outputs, and the human checkpoints that need to stay in the loop
Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent output quality and tie results back to marketing KPIs
Stay current on new AI tools and revisit existing workflows to incorporate improvements as the technology moves




Who you are:




2 to 3+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, technical marketing, or a role where you owned both strategy and build
You've shipped internal tools that teams fully adopted and used to inflect marketing KPIs
You understand user behavior in a B2C funnel: what good activation looks like, where drop-off happens, and how to design around it
Experience with marketing automation platforms (Iterable, Smartly, or similar); you know how to build and optimize triggered campaigns, not just run them
You can build autonomously using low-code and AI tools; you don't need an engineering ticket to ship
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation loops
Experience building with tools like Zapier, Clay, Framer, or Lovable




If you have read up to this point, we hope you are excited about this opportunity to work at Wonolo! Even if your experience does not check every bullet point, we still highly encourage you to apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description.




Nice to haves:




Experience in a marketplace or gig economy product with a two-sided user base

Company laptop

Ability to work from anywhere in Colombia, El Salvador, Costa Rica, or Guatemala (no more commutes!)

Important Notice Regarding Fraudulent Recruiting




Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @wonolo.com email addresses.




Employment scammers may impersonate legitimate recruiters, employers, or recruitment firms, using email, text messages, messaging apps (including, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, etc.), or fake social media accounts to contact you. They may advertise roles that do not exist, claim to represent Wonolo, or use our name and branding without authorization.




Wonolo is aware that individuals posing as recruiters have communicated with job seekers about positions with Wonolo that do not exist. We have received reports that the content and method of communication has varied, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive personal information.




Wonolo will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information. All open positions are posted in country specific employment portals available at https://info.wonolo.com/careers/. All legitimate job postings on third-party employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application directly through the Wonolo careers page.




Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Wonolo’s recruiting process in general should email recruiting@wonolo.com.

Why G2 Venture Partners Invested in Wonolo

Yong Kim (CEO) on why he's passionate about empowering the in-demand workforce

Wonolo welcomes you as you and celebrates our collective diversity. We work to serve the underserved, and we are built on the strength of our entire community. We know that diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make for the best teams, and help to drive high performance. We strive to ensure that our team represents different cultures, perspectives, and backgrounds, as these empower our team to come together to make the best decisions and the biggest impact.

Individuals seeking to work at or with Wonolo are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

About our client

Our client manufactures premium powder-coated garage door hardware sold through dealers and distributors across the continental US. Our flagship line and patent-pending are sold B2B through an authorized dealer program and distribution partnerships. Marketing here directly drives dealer acquisition, distributor partnerships, and reorder revenue.




About the Role 

You will own marketing execution across two lanes: always-on brand and social content, and structured launch campaigns for product releases and distribution partnerships. Recent example of the second lane: a multi-week partner launch coordinated across two companies, covering teaser and announcement social sequences, a trade press release, a segmented three-email campaign, dealer and rep enablement collateral, and post-launch lead capture into our CRM. You will build the plan, track every asset, hit the gates, and report on results.




This is an AI-forward role. We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier across everything you do here: drafting and refining copy, generating and iterating imagery, building campaign plans, analyzing performance, and automating the repetitive parts of your own workflow. If you are a 9 out of 10 on putting AI to work in marketing, you will thrive here. If you are still writing everything from a blank page and waiting on a designer for every graphic, this is not the right fit.




What You'll Do 

Campaign management

description:
About the job

Role Title: 360° Video Recorder (Insta360 / GoPro MAX)




Role Type: Contractor




Location: Remote




micro1 is engaging 360° Video Recorders (Insta360 / GoPro MAX) to contribute to a customer's project by capturing immersive, high-quality footage with leading 360° camera equipment. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform.




We are looking for individuals to collect third-person video across several real-world capture types, including movement through changing environments, vehicle navigation, and animal-mounted POV recordings. Recordings should focus on continuous movement, changing scenery, and natural navigation through the environment.




Camera Requirements




You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:




- A minimum 170° field of view (FOV)

- A minimum recording resolution of 720p




Compatible camera examples include:




- Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6

- DJI Osmo 360

- GoPro MAX, MAX2

- Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements




Mounting Equipment




You do not need to already own the required mounting equipment to apply.




Depending on the task, you may need:




- A rigid backpack, harness, or similar third-person mounting rig with an extension arm or pole

- A secure vehicle camera mount for vehicle navigation recordings




Already owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may allow you to begin collecting sooner.




Reasonable equipment costs for required mounting hardware may be reimbursed.




Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:




- Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension system




Third-Person Camera Setup




The camera must be:

- Mounted above and behind you

- Angled slightly downward

- Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible

- Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement




If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment.




Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.




Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.




Expected Recording Tasks may include:

- Natural everyday activities

- Indoor and outdoor activities

- Walking and moving through different environments

- Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings

- Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions




For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.




Recording Requirements

- Capture a variety of activities and environments

- Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long

- Record at a minimum resolution of 720p

- Follow the required camera position for each assigned task

- Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible

- Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

Compensation

- Rate: $20 per hour of approved video (PPT)

- Payment is based on the duration of video that successfully passes quality review and is accepted for delivery.

About the job

Who We Are

A Christian behavioral health organization with clinics in Florida and Cozumel, Mexico is looking for a digital PR and outreach specialist to build our authority through earned media, professional listings, and expert placements.

You will work directly with our founder, a PsyD who has founded three behavioral health organizations, is a published author with his own publishing imprint, and has appeared on Christian television. You will also work with our staff psychiatrist, a board certified MD with peer reviewed publications. Your job is to turn those credentials into third party coverage, citations, and links.

This is earned media work. We do not buy links or placements, and candidates who propose that will not be considered. We evaluate you on real conversations you open and coverage you earn, not on volume of email sent.




What you will do

Research and build target lists of credible outlets, then find and verify the right editor, producer, or contact at each
Draft personalized pitches for our founder's approval and signature. Every pitch is specific to one outlet and one person. No templates.

Helpful but not required: familiarity with healthcare, behavioral health, or any regulated industry. Familiarity with Christian media or faith based audiences. Experience with AI search visibility, sometimes called GEO or AEO. Experience with academic or research citations.

Automatic disqualifiers: proposing to buy links, guest posts, or placements. Private blog networks. Guaranteed placement volume. AI generated pitches sent at scale.




How we measure the role

We split KPIs into two groups on purpose. Leading indicators show whether the machine is running. Outcomes show whether the work is landing. Reporting either one alone does not tell us the role is working. "I sent 200 emails" is not a result.

About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be the engine behind Paystand's B2B payments platform. This is an operator-focused role designed for a builder who thrives on shipping high-quality code and features. You will own the full product development lifecycle, ensuring that our core payment infrastructure is not only robust but consistently evolving to address the specific needs of the LATAM B2B payment market, including navigating regional financial complexities and local market requirements. You will bridge the gap between technical complexity and user value, unblocking engineering squads, managing tight release cycles, and directly driving the velocity of our product roadmap.

Key Responsibilities


End-to-End Execution: Own the product backlog, user stories, and requirements. You are responsible for taking features from initial concept to deployment, ensuring that what gets built matches the business requirement and technical specs.
Product Velocity: Drive the day-to-day operations of your product area. Lead sprint planning, unblock engineering teams, and make the daily trade-off decisions necessary to keep features on track and on time.
Technical Partnership: Work daily with Engineering and Design to translate complex financial/ERP requirements into clear, buildable tasks. Act as the primary technical point of contact to ensure architectural integrity and system performance.
Operational Excellence: Define and monitor success metrics (e.g., release quality, cycle time, adoption rates) and lead the post-launch analysis to iterate and improve features immediately.
Backlog Management: Maintain a high-quality, prioritized backlog. Proactively identify dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the team is always focused on the most impactful work.
LATAM Product Leadership: Own the LATAM product roadmap, leading product discovery and delivery efforts tailored to the regional ecosystem, including core LATAM products such as Yaydoo and PorCobrar.


What We Are Looking For


5+ years of Product Management experience: Specifically in B2B SaaS, fintech, or complex platform environments.
Operator Mindset: You are a "Builder." You prefer working in the weeds with engineers to solve technical blockers over high-level conceptual planning.
Technical Fluency: You are comfortable working with APIs, data schemas, and cloud-native architectures. You don’t need to write the code, but you must be able to hold your own in technical debates with engineers.
Execution Track Record: A proven history of shipping complex features in high-velocity environments. You can point to products you’ve built and how you managed the development lifecycle to get them live.
Systems Thinking: The ability to decompose complex financial workflows (AR/AP, Reconciliation, ERP integration) into manageable, shippable components.
LATAM Regulatory & Financial Expertise: Deep experience with Mexican/LATAM financial regulations, billing ecosystems (e.g., CFDI/SAT in Mexico, DIAN in Colombia), and local fintech or ERP landscapes.


Nice to Have


Direct experience with ERP ecosystems (NetSuite).
Experience in the payments or financial infrastructure space, including LATAM payment rails like SPEI.
Experience driving product-led growth (PLG) initiatives in B2B.


Why Paystand


Paystand is on a mission to reinvent commercial finance and bring B2B payments into the digital age.
You will join a team focused on product innovation, customer success, and disrupting outdated financial systems.
You will work with forward-thinking finance teams to build modern payment infrastructure.
You will help build the next version of Paystand: a high-ownership organization where your ability to execute has a direct, measurable impact on global B2B commerce.


Perks & Benefits


Enjoy generous PTO and sick leave, because we believe in balance.
Fuel your days with free snacks and paid lunches in the office.
We've got your health covered with Major Medical Health Insurance.
Stay nourished with food vouchers and plan for your future with savings funds.
Unlock stock options and own a piece of our success!
Work with the best tools and equipment, setting you up to thrive.
And the best part? Endless growth opportunities await you as we rapidly expand!


If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply.

We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity.

Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you.

Most of our roles are onsite. Positions that are eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements will be clearly indicated in the job posting.

For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.

About the job

Hey there!

We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Meet The Team

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.

We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high-quality service.

From intimate Candlelight Private Concert or a large-scale multi-city activation, we turn live entertainment into a repeatable business solution that drives employee engagement and brand differentiation. Our team owns the full journey from initial sales and strategy to global execution working closely with Fever Originals and Operations to scale B2B experiences smoothly and at a global level.

Join us if you are excited about redefining B2B entertainment, build global partnerships, and turn world-class culture into a seamless business service.

The Role

We are looking for a tenured Sr. Account Executive to help build and scale our emerging Fever for Business unit across LATAM, bringing the full power of Fever to corporate and institutional clients in a fast-growing market. In this role, you will take ownership of a targeted book of business within the Strategic & Enterprise segments, while also shaping our local go-to-market approach - defining strategy, advising prospects on their needs within the culture and live entertainment space and driving net new revenue. Your expertise in consultative selling, combined with strong deal execution and cross-functional alignment, will be critical to accelerating our expansion and establishing a high-impact B2B presence in the region.

Consistently meet and exceed monthly and quarterly revenue targets
Take ownership in pipeline creation and deal cycle management, applying MEDDIC-style Sales methodologies
Drive New Logo growth and a land & expand motion for our top tier customers
Leverage Fever’s ecosystem and your own network to identify and engage ideal prospects
Identify, map, and multi-thread key stakeholders in your territory 
Craft and execute creative outreach strategies to drive pipeline quality
Build lasting client relationships that generate recurring revenue
Collaborate cross-functionally (Marketing, Partners, Operations) to ensure alignment
Conduct market research to stay informed about industry trends and competitors
Thrive on change while remaining highly organized, adaptable, optimistic, and coachable
